name: headless-app-tanstack
title: Headless App for TanStack Start
description: Give your agents a backend: sign-in, OAuth consent, an MCP server, and a page to connect and revoke agents.

files.content:
# Supabase configuration for a headless app: password auth for the product
# session, an OAuth 2.1 server for external agents, and the MCP server that both
# call. Values below are for local development — run `supabase config push` to
# apply the same settings to a linked project.

project_id = "headless-app"

[api]
enabled = true
port = 54321
schemas = ["public", "graphql_public"]
extra_search_path = ["public", "extensions"]
max_rows = 1000

[db]
port = 54322
shadow_port = 54320
major_version = 17

[studio]
enabled = true
port = 54323

[inbucket]
enabled = true
port = 54324

[auth]
enabled = true
# Origin that serves this app, including /oauth/consent. Use HTTPS in production.
site_url = "http://localhost:3000"
additional_redirect_urls = ["http://localhost:3000/**"]
jwt_expiry = 3600
enable_signup = true

[auth.email]
enable_signup = true
# Confirmations are off so local sign-ups can reach the app immediately.
enable_confirmations = false

# External MCP clients authorize here. Auth sends the user to
# authorization_url_path, which the OAuth Consent block serves.
[auth.oauth_server]
enabled = true
authorization_url_path = "/oauth/consent"
# Lets any compatible client register itself. Set to false to register clients
# yourself.
allow_dynamic_registration = true

# The MCP server verifies user access tokens itself, so skip the gateway check.
[functions.mcp-server]
verify_jwt = false

docs:
Set `site_url` in `supabase/config.toml` to the origin serving your app, and `PRODUCT_NAME` in `routes/_protected/agents.tsx`. Run `supabase config push` and `supabase functions deploy mcp-server`, then sign in and open `/agents` to connect an agent. Add tools in `supabase/functions/mcp-server/tools/`.

You'll need to set the following environment variables in your project: `VITE_SUPABASE_URL` and `VITE_SUPABASE_PUBLISHABLE_KEY`.
